summary: I am an AI Product Leader who quickly understands how industries and products work, translates problems that have yet to be articulated into technical terms, and connects them to product and business outcomes.

Across fintech AutoML, healthcare Computer Vision, e-commerce LLM Application, and Generative AI video products, I have built teams, secured enterprise contracts, grown MRR 10x, and taken a web product to official launch.

When I enter a new domain, I first map the product's infrastructure and systems along with the market. I then use our own products and competing products to find gaps that have not been clearly defined. I put problems tightly coupled to the core system on the organization's agenda. When a point of user friction can be tested independently, I prototype it myself. I work with the team beyond implementation until we see concrete outcomes, such as contracts, paid conversion, or reaching FSO (First Satisfactory Output) without leaving the Golden Path.
